description: The animation layers of the characters of a Game Kit project (gkp_…), part of the generic animation layer of the kits (packages/gamekits/src/runtime/anim-layers.ts, mixed in Rust by the players: Bevy on the web and natively, libgfkits for Godot / Unity / Unreal). An action (attack, heavy_attack, punch, kick, ability, shoot, reload, throw, block, emote, interact, hit, body) plays on the parts of the body its layer takes over the locomotion, which keeps the rest: attacking while running keeps the legs running and the player moving. Defaults: a one-hand attack while moving = upper body (legs and hips to the locomotion, waist blended), standing still = whole body; movement free. NEVER recode a blend of animations, a bone mask or a movement lock in game code: set the layer here. action=table (default): the masks (full, upper, torso, lower, legs, arms, arm_right, arm_left, head, upper_right, upper_left; regions hips, spine, chest, head, arm_l, arm_r, leg_l, leg_r), the action families with their states and their default layer. action=get: the layers the project sets — actionLayers of its character kits (character.third_person, character.first_person, character.top_down: by family or by state such as attack3) and weaponLayers of weapons.loadout (by weapon id). action=set { kit, key, layer }: one entry, layer = { mask, still, weight, mode: replace | additive, fadeIn, fadeOut, movement: free | slow | lock | root, moveScale } (mask / still: a mask name or { regions: { <region>: 0..1 }, bones: { <bone>: 0..1 } }); the kit validates it, mods may override it (the keys are moddable), the hook character.action decides the movement once per action and player.action reports it. action=clear { kit, key }: back to the defaults. Existing games get the defaults without any change; nothing is recompiled. 0 credits.

key.description: set / clear: an action family (attack, shoot…), a state (attack3) or, for weapons.loadout, a weapon id.

kit.description: set / clear: the kit whose table is changed (weapons.loadout: by weapon id).

layer.description: set: { mask, still, weight, mode, fadeIn, fadeOut, movement, moveScale }.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…): required for get, set and clear; table needs none.

reason.description: One sentence: why, recorded in the project history.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_anim_layers
title: Animation layers: what an action keeps or blends of the body, and of the movement
